data.name: UserAlreadyExistsInDirectory
data.value: User with this email already exists in LDAP.

data.name: UserAlreadyExists
data.value: User already exists.
data.comment: Bulk create: one item of the batch.

data.name: UserNotFoundForUpdate
data.value: User not found for update.
data.comment: Bulk update: one item of the batch.

data.name: BulkCreateFieldsRequired
data.value: Email, name and password are required for create operations.

data.name: BulkOperationUnknown
data.value: Unknown operation '{0}'. Use 'create' or 'update'.

data.name: DirectoryEnumerationIncomplete
data.value: The directory could not be enumerated completely, so it cannot be established whether this user exists.

data.name: DirectoryUnreachable
data.value: The directory could not be reached.

data.name: DirectoryServerNotConfigured
data.value: This directory has no server configured. Choose another directory, or ask an administrator to set its server.

data.name: DirectoryProviderUnknown
data.value: Directory provider '{0}' is not configured or is not active.
data.comment: {0} = provider id supplied in X-LDAP-Provider-Id.

data.name: DirectoryProviderUnreachable
data.value: No endpoint could be reached for directory provider '{0}'.
data.comment: {0} = provider id supplied in X-LDAP-Provider-Id.

data.name: DirectoryProviderMisconfigured
data.value: Directory provider '{0}' is misconfigured and cannot be used. Contact an administrator.
data.comment: {0} = provider id supplied in X-LDAP-Provider-Id.

data.name: DirectorySearchFailed
data.value: The directory could not be searched for the account.
data.comment: No placeholder on purpose: the caller knows which account it asked about, and this text is logged as well.

data.name: DirectoryCredentialCheckFailed
data.value: The directory could not verify the credentials.
data.comment: No placeholder on purpose: the caller knows which account it asked about, and this text is logged as well.

data.name: DirectoryGroupMembershipFailed
data.value: The directory could not report group membership.
data.comment: No placeholder on purpose: the caller knows which account it asked about, and this text is logged as well.

data.name: DirectoryRejectedCreate
data.value: The directory rejected the creation of the entry.
data.comment: No placeholder on purpose: the caller knows which account it asked about, and this text is logged as well.

data.name: DirectoryRejectedUpdate
data.value: The directory rejected the update of the entry.
data.comment: No placeholder on purpose: the caller knows which account it asked about, and this text is logged as well.

data.name: DirectoryRejectedDelete
data.value: The directory rejected the deletion of the entry.
data.comment: No placeholder on purpose: the caller knows which account it asked about, and this text is logged as well.

data.name: UserNotFoundInLdap
data.value: User not found in LDAP.
data.comment: No placeholder on purpose: the caller knows which account it asked about, and this text is logged as well.

data.name: UserNotFoundInAd
data.value: User not found in AD.
data.comment: No placeholder on purpose: the caller knows which account it asked about, and this text is logged as well.

data.name: WriteOperationsUnsupportedOnGlobalCatalog
data.value: LDAP write operations are not supported on Global Catalog ports 3268/3269. Use writable LDAP/LDAPS port 389/636 and a target OU DN for create/update/delete.

data.name: OrganizationalUnitNameRequired
data.value: An organizational unit name is required.

data.name: OrganizationalUnitNotFound
data.value: Organizational unit '{0}' was not found in the directory.
data.comment: {0} = identifier or distinguished name.

data.name: OrganizationalUnitLookupIncomplete
data.value: The directory could not be enumerated in full, so organizational unit '{0}' could neither be found nor ruled out. Try again.
data.comment: {0} = identifier.

data.name: OrganizationalUnitAlreadyExists
data.value: An entry already exists at '{0}'.
data.comment: {0} = distinguished name.

data.name: OrganizationalUnitNotEmpty
data.value: Organizational unit '{0}' still contains entries and cannot be deleted. Move or delete its contents first.
data.comment: {0} = distinguished name.

data.name: OrganizationalUnitsUnsupportedByAdProvider
data.value: Organizational unit management is not implemented for the Windows ActiveDirectory provider. Set Ldap:ProviderType to StandardLdap — it manages organizational units in Active Directory as well.

data.name: GroupNameRequired
data.value: A group name is required.

data.name: GroupMembersRequired
data.value: A group must have at least one member: the directory schema makes 'member' mandatory for a groupOfNames, so a group with nobody in it cannot be stored. Add a member distinguished name, or delete the group instead of emptying it.

data.name: GroupNotFound
data.value: Group '{0}' was not found in the directory.
data.comment: {0} = identifier or distinguished name.

data.name: GroupLookupIncomplete
data.value: The directory could not be enumerated in full, so group '{0}' could neither be found nor ruled out. Try again.
data.comment: {0} = identifier.

data.name: GroupAlreadyExists
data.value: An entry already exists at '{0}'.
data.comment: {0} = distinguished name.

data.name: GroupNotEmptyContainer
data.value: Group '{0}' has entries beneath it in the directory tree and cannot be deleted. Move or delete them first.
data.comment: {0} = distinguished name.

data.name: GroupsUnsupportedByAdProvider
data.value: Group management is not implemented for the Windows ActiveDirectory provider. Set Ldap:ProviderType to StandardLdap — it manages groups in Active Directory as well.

data.name: UserAttributesUnsupportedByAdProvider
data.value: Reading raw directory attributes is not implemented for the Windows ActiveDirectory provider. Set Ldap:ProviderType to StandardLdap — it reads them from Active Directory as well.

data.name: ComputerNameRequired
data.value: A computer name is required.

data.name: ComputerNotFound
data.value: Computer '{0}' was not found in the directory.
data.comment: {0} = identifier or distinguished name.

data.name: ComputerLookupIncomplete
data.value: The directory could not be enumerated completely, so it cannot be established whether computer '{0}' exists.
data.comment: {0} = identifier.

data.name: ComputerAlreadyExists
data.value: Computer '{0}' already exists in the directory.
data.comment: {0} = distinguished name.

data.name: ComputerNotEmptyContainer
data.value: Computer '{0}' still contains entries and cannot be deleted. Move or delete its contents first.
data.comment: {0} = distinguished name.

data.name: ComputersUnsupportedByAdProvider
data.value: Computer management is not implemented for the Windows ActiveDirectory provider. Set Ldap:ProviderType to StandardLdap — it manages computer accounts in Active Directory as well.

data.name: BulkRequestEmpty
data.value: Bulk request must contain at least one item.

data.name: AuthenticationRequired
data.value: Authentication is required for this operation.

data.name: PermissionDenied
data.value: You are not permitted to perform this operation.

data.name: PatternRequired
data.value: Pattern is required for generation.

data.name: PageSizeOutOfRange
data.value: Page size must be between {0} and {1}.

data.name: GeneratedItemLimitOutOfRange
data.value: The number of items to generate must be between {0} and {1}.

data.name: TargetHoldsMorePermissions
data.value: You cannot change this account or group: it holds permissions you do not have yourself.
data.comment: Refusal to act on an account or group that grants permissions the caller does not hold.

data.name: SessionEntryGone
data.value: Your account is no longer where it was when you signed in. Sign in again.
data.comment: The directory entry the session was opened for has been moved, renamed or deleted.

data.name: EmailAlreadyInUse
data.value: Another account in the directory already uses this email address.
data.comment: An address change would give an account an address another account already answers to.

data.name: BindPasswordRequiredForNewEndpoint
data.value: Enter the bind password again to change the host, port or failover hosts. The saved password is only ever sent to the servers it was entered for.
data.comment: Changing a provider's host, port or failover hosts without re-entering its bind password.

data.name: RoleUnknown
data.value: There is no role called '{0}'.
data.comment: {0} = the role name the caller gave.

data.name: RoleNotEditable
data.value: The {0} role always holds every permission and cannot be edited. To give someone fewer rights, map their group to another role.
data.comment: {0} = the role, Admin. It holds every permission and is not edited.

data.name: PermissionNotGrantable
data.value: {0} cannot be granted to this role: whoever holds it can make themselves an administrator. Map the group to the Admin role instead.
data.comment: {0} = the permission, roles.manage, which is held by Admin alone.

data.name: CannotGrantUnheldPermission
data.value: You cannot grant a permission you do not hold yourself.
data.comment: Refusal to grant a role a permission the caller does not hold.

data.name: TargetIsProtected
data.value: This account or group is privileged in the directory (for example, a member of Domain Admins). Only an administrator of this application can change it.
data.comment: Refusal to change an account or group the directory treats as privileged (adminCount, protected groups).

data.name: ServiceAccountNotManaged
data.value: This is the account the application itself uses to connect to the directory. It cannot be changed through the application.
data.comment: Refusal to change the account the application binds to the directory as.

data.name: PasswordRejectedByDirectory
data.value: The directory rejected the new password. It probably does not meet the password policy (length, complexity or history).
data.comment: The directory refused a new password, usually because of its password policy.

data.name: PasswordChangeNeedsEncryption
data.value: Active Directory only accepts a new password over an encrypted connection. Connect to the directory with LDAPS.
data.comment: Active Directory refused unicodePwd because the connection is not encrypted.

data.name: PasswordChangeUnsupported
data.value: This directory offers no safe way to set a password (neither Active Directory nor the LDAP Password Modify operation), so none was written.
data.comment: The directory offers neither Active Directory's unicodePwd nor the LDAP Password Modify operation.

data.name: DirectoryCertificateRejected
data.value: The directory's TLS certificate could not be verified, so the connection was not used. Ask an administrator to check the certificate and the trusted certificate authority.

data.name: LdapSecurityUnknown
data.value: '{0}' is not a connection security mode. Use Ldaps, StartTls or None.
data.comment: {0} = the rejected value.

data.name: BindPasswordRequiredForPlainLdap
data.value: Enter the bind password again to switch this directory to unencrypted LDAP. Without encryption the saved password would cross the network readable by anyone on the way.
data.comment: Switching a provider to unencrypted LDAP (security None) without re-entering its bind password.
